intro.heading: DEMO: A room that works before it looks good
intro.text: DEMO copy: Most bathrooms go wrong at the drawing stage, not the fitting. I measure the room, draw it to scale and show you where every pipe will run before anything is ordered.

stories.heading: DEMO: Drawn around the room you have
stories.text: DEMO copy: Awkward rooms are the norm. The drawing is where we solve the soil pipe, the window and the door swing.

stories.heading: DEMO: One fitter from first day to last
stories.text: DEMO copy: The same person sets out, tiles and fits the room. You always know who is in the house.
